_comment: Live settings for JinxyClicker. Edit this file on GitHub and every copy of the app picks it up next time it opens - no release, nobody re-downloading. It can only change numbers and turn features off; it cannot change how the app works. Anything missing, misspelled or out of range falls back to the value the app shipped with, so a mistake here is harmless.
_hitFixMinDownMs: How long a click is held down, at minimum. 1-100, ships as 15.
_hitFixMinUpMs: The minimum gap between clicks. 1-100, ships as 15.
_macroEquipMs: How long a weapon takes to appear before clicks count. 0-1000, ships as 60.
_recorderEnabled: Set false to switch the recorder off everywhere, if the encoder turns out to be broken.
_kitArtFetchEnabled: Set false to stop fetching missing kit pictures from the wiki.
_notice: A short line shown in the app - for saying a problem is known and a fix is coming. Empty means nothing is shown. Max 200 characters.
